The oil tank is installed above the turbine. The leakage oil coming from the 
turbine returns to the turbine. The leakage oil coming from the turbine returns 
to the lower leakage tank pump provides oil flow through the return filter and 
back to the oil tank the oil return from servo motor directly back to the oil 
tank
Filtering of leakage oil, control of the filters and control of the oil.

The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Introduction
